process.header: How we turn chaos into processes?
process.step1_desc: Form submission through our website. Preliminary analysis of your industry by our system.
process.step2_desc: Conversation with a specialist. Identifying bottlenecks and areas for digitalization.
process.step3_desc: Calculation of investment profitability. Black and white - see exactly how much you'll save.
process.step4_desc: Settling technical and business details. Transparent conditions, no hidden asterisks.
process.step5_desc: Depending on complexity, the first version (MVP) reaches you in 2-4 weeks. We focus on the Core Value.
process.step6_desc: Real-world verification. We gather feedback from your staff and make improvements.
process.step7_desc: Official system launch. Staff training and post-deployment support (SLA).
